name: aversion to owing
quote: How can I pay you back?
description: Social anxiety from a perception that you need to provide an asset or perform an action for someone that helped you in order to meet expectations of fairness.
perceptions: That person or group did something to help or let me borrow something.
There's an expectation that I pay them back or return the favor.
desires: desire to be perceived a certain way
results: Make a mental note or write yourself a note to pay them back.

guidance.description: If stress about debt is an issue, here are some references.
If you're averse to asking for help because you don't want to owe a favor, you might consider this reference.

examples: Not wanting to owe people money.
Being anxious about owing people favors.

commentaries.quote: Debt can turn a free, happy person into a bitter human being.
A man who pays his bills on time is soon forgotten.
Creditors have better memories than debtors.
To feel oppressed by obligation is only to prove that we are incapable of a proper sentiment of gratitude.
